summary: Playback Evidence Service run 34739835844 successfully processed pending requests and created durable evidence locally, but failed to publish because git pull --rebase hit a content conflict in another agent's concurrently updated playback evidence file. Subsequent bounded retries remained inside the unresolved rebase state and could not recover.

evidence.failure_mode: After the first rebase conflict, the retry loop did not abort/reset the rebase before retrying, so attempts 2-5 immediately failed with unmerged files.

impact: Successfully generated evidence from unrelated cases can be lost from the runner when any concurrently changed evidence file conflicts during rebase. Playback progress is delayed even though media processing succeeded.
recommended_admin_action: Make the publish step recover from rebase conflicts by aborting/resetting to fresh origin/main and reapplying only generated output paths, or use a serialized writer/merge-safe publication strategy. Each bounded retry must begin from a clean Git state.
worker_action: Reported only. No protected workflow or script was modified by this worker.
